meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought

examples.trans: I would think about it.
I'd buy a house.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: I have a toy car.
Childhood was hard.
You will be asking for forgiveness.
The kind wolf is looking for the bunny.

examples.text: В сказке серый волк говорил голосом человека.
examples.trans: In the fairy tale the grey wolf spoke with a human voice.
See you!
I have a meeting.

examples.text: Решается ваш вопрос, Клавдия Викторовна! Вы не видите, у меня встреча?
examples.trans: Your question is being sorted out, Klavdia Viktorovna! Can't you see I have a meeting?
I am very hungry.
Thank you, Chef, I am very hungry!

examples.text: Наши гости в зале очень голодные.
examples.trans: Our guests in the hall are very hungry.
I'm cooking lunch.
Mum cooks well.

examples.text: Я уже не могу готовить, стирать, убирать. Я хочу на море!
examples.trans: I can't take the cooking, washing and cleaning any more. I want to go to the sea!
Goodbye!
See you tomorrow!
See you tonight!

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: to a loved one, and at the start of letters

examples.trans: These are expensive clothes.
Darling, I'm home!

examples.text: В Москве вам дают деньги на дорогую одежду, а мозги не дают.
examples.trans: In Moscow they give you money for expensive clothes, but they don't give you brains.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.
He's my friend.

examples.text: Это Паша, мой заместитель. Это Ваня, друг моего детства.
examples.trans: This is Pasha, my deputy. This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.trans: But you've still got some.
But I know.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Здрасьте, а вы вообще кто и откуда пришли?
examples.trans: Hello there, and who are you anyway and where did you come from?

examples.text: Ну здрасьте, опять холодильник не работает!
examples.trans: Well hello, the refrigerator is not working again!

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: How was it in Hungary?
As you all know...
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Of course I'll help.
Yes, of course.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?
Who are your rivals?
Who's there?
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?
She was manipulating me all along!
You must not manipulate people for profit.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

офигеть.gloss: to be stunned; (as exclamation) no way!, wow!

meanings.en: to be stunned, to be gobsmacked
(офигели?) to lose one's mind, to get too cheeky

examples.trans: Have they completely lost their minds?
No way, is that really you?

meanings.en: to manipulate (a bit, for a while)

examples.trans: I wish someone would manipulate me like that!
He likes to manipulate people.
Give Mum a kiss.
He kissed her.
Kiss me.

приготовить.gloss: to prepare, to cook, to make

meanings.en: to cook, to make (food), to prepare

examples.trans: I made a cake.
Mum cooked a delicious dinner.

examples.text: Я торт приготовила. Ты любишь сладкое?
examples.trans: I made a cake. Do you have a sweet tooth?
I'm at home today.
I'll be there tonight.

examples.text: Виктор Степанович, сегодня никак не могу.
examples.trans: Viktor Stepanovich, I really can't today.
First they were rude and insulting over there.
Let's start everything from the beginning.

examples.text: Мы танцевали. Сначала они там грубили, оскорбляли.
examples.trans: We were dancing. First they were rude and insulting over there.

соскучиться.gloss: to miss, to grow lonely for

meanings.en: to miss someone (+ по + dat.), to start missing

examples.trans: Because I missed you, kitty!
Do you think I didn't miss you?

examples.text: Ты думаешь, я не соскучился? Я уже на стенку лезу!
examples.trans: Do you think I didn't miss you? I'm already climbing the wall!

meanings.note: At the start of a question.

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
That's good like that.
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?
Lyolya will definitely come!

examples.text: Я точно не помню его адрес.
examples.trans: I don't remember his exact address.

examples.text: Точно, полиция была! А что с машиной?
examples.trans: That's right, the police were there! And what about the car?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: You're greedy!
Have you got any more?
Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: Удачи! = Good luck! (genitive: 'I wish you luck')

examples.trans: Good luck to you!
That's a real stroke of luck.

examples.text: Нет, не получается у меня это забыть. Удачи тебе на новом месте работы.
examples.trans: No, I just can't forget it. Good luck to you in your new job.

meanings.note: impersonal with dative: мне/вам хочется = I/you feel like, really want

examples.text: Я понимаю, вам очень хочется квартиру.
examples.trans: I understand you really want the flat.
I really feel like sleeping.

examples.text: Самсоновы, ну вы очнитесь! Я понимаю, вам очень хочется квартиру.
examples.trans: Samsonovs, come to your senses! I understand you really want the flat.
I will think of something.
Say something.

examples.text: Правда, Нин, всё нормально. Скажи что-нибудь, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Honestly, Nina, everything's fine. Say something, please.

meanings.note: instrumental чем-то: чем-то помочь = help with something

examples.text: Так может быть, тебе надо чем-то помочь?
examples.trans: So maybe you need help with something?
Can I help with anything?

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
